subject.name: Environmental Management
subject.examPattern: AS only: P1 1 h 45, 80 marks (4–6 structured questions + 1 essay of 2, 50%) + P2 1 h 45, 80 marks (4–6 structured questions, 50%). No A2 content.

items.name: Natural resources: energy, water and food

subtopics.name: Structure of the Earth and plate tectonics: plate boundaries and their landforms
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Tectonics and continental drift (Lower Secondary Stage 9); structure of the Earth (IGCSE Geography)

subtopics.name: The rock cycle: formation of igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic rocks
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Types of rock and weathering (Lower Secondary Stage 7-8)

subtopics.name: Natural hazards: earthquakes, volcanoes and tsunamis, their impacts and management
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Plate boundaries; hazard and risk (IGCSE Geography)

subtopics.name: Mineral extraction: mining methods, environmental impacts and restoration

subtopics.name: The hydrological cycle: stores, flows and processes

subtopics.name: Oceans: ocean currents, upwelling and El Niño Southern Oscillation
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Convection currents (IGCSE Physics ch 11)

subtopics.name: Air pollution: acid rain, photochemical smog and particulates

subtopics.name: Ecosystems: energy flow, trophic levels, food chains and food webs, and productivity
